title: Practice: Reverse the digits
description:
Reverse the decimal digits of n and return the result as an integer. Use a function argument, not stdin. Constraint: 0 <= n <= 1000000000. Discard leading zeros in the result.

Examples: 123 -> 321; 1200 -> 21; 0 -> 0.
reference: int reverse_digits(int n) { int result = 0; while (n > 0) { result = result * 10 + n % 10; n /= 10; } return result; }
